requirements.title: Compressive field
requirements.manuscript_statement: M is an inward compressive field in R^3_comp.
requirements.software_requirement: Represent M as exactly three finite numerical components: Mx, My, Mz.

requirements.title: Repulsive field
requirements.manuscript_statement: A is an outward repulsive field in R^3_rep.
requirements.software_requirement: Represent A as exactly three finite numerical components: Ax, Ay, Az.

requirements.title: Six-component local state
requirements.manuscript_statement: The intersecting space-field matrix couples three compressive and three repulsive dimensions.
requirements.software_requirement: Represent one local state as Psi=(Mx,My,Mz,Ax,Ay,Az).

requirements.title: Gradient autonomy
requirements.manuscript_statement: D is proportional to -grad(M); no hardcoded trajectory depends on intrinsic particle properties.
requirements.software_requirement: Compute propagation from the supplied compressive-field gradient only.
open_questions: Spatial embedding of the third axis

requirements.title: Local gradient dominance
requirements.software_requirement: Compare field norms and declare dominance only against an explicit threshold.

requirements.title: Coupled field duality
requirements.software_requirement: Advance M and A together with equal and opposite increments.

requirements.title: Boundary jam
requirements.manuscript_statement: A cell jams at maximum tension when adjacent resistance gradient tends to infinity.
requirements.software_requirement: Require both tension-capacity and resistance-threshold conditions.

requirements.title: Phase lock
requirements.software_requirement: Calculate ||M-A|| and compare with a declared tolerance.

requirements.title: Non-truncating ejection
requirements.software_requirement: Preserve the complete structural state before resetting the local coordinate.

requirements.title: Global tensegrity equilibrium
requirements.software_requirement: Report scalar and component-wise global balance.
open_questions: Whether scalar balance alone is sufficient

requirements.title: Sensitivity response
requirements.software_requirement: Multiply sensitivity matrix by external perturbation vector.
open_questions: Units and provenance of S and delta E

requirements.title: Bifurcation
requirements.manuscript_statement: det(S) -> 0 indicates transition to a nonlinear regime.
requirements.software_requirement: Calculate det(S) and compare to a declared threshold.

requirements.title: Original Z6 trace
requirements.manuscript_statement: Original source code defines sigma=Trace(Psi_barrier) mod 6.
requirements.software_requirement: Return stable only when the trace residue equals zero.

requirements.title: 64-cell field frame
requirements.manuscript_statement: User-defined architecture is based on a 64-grid matrix.
requirements.software_requirement: Support an 8x8 coordinate frame with explicit empty and overflow states.
open_questions: One scalar, one subgroup, or one six-component state per cell
